item.title: EU to propose permanent ban on Russian oil after Hungary election, document shows
item.description: The European Commission will submit a legal proposal to permanently ban Russian oil imports on April 15, three days after Hungary’s parliamentary election, according to EU officials and a document seen by Reuters. Two EU officials told Reuters the timing was designed to prevent the oil ban becoming a major factor in Hungary’s election campaign. […]

item.title: Island-wide foot-and-mouth vaccinations begin as virus found circulating since early February
item.description: Cyprus has launched a sweeping island-wide vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease, as epidemiological evidence suggests the highly contagious virus has been circulating in government-controlled areas since at least early February.
